name: Water Body Delineation and River Morphometry
description:
You are an environmental hydrologist analyzing the Nile River. Your goal is to extract morphometric parameters from a satellite image.

1. Open the 'Nile Bend' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Nile Bend).
2. Delineate the water body (the dark river channel) from the land using thresholding (Image > Adjust > Threshold). You may need to clean up the binary mask using morphological operations (Process > Binary > ...) to remove noise or fill holes.
3. Measure the following parameters:
   - Total Water Surface Area (in pixels squared)
   - River Channel Width at 3 distinct cross-sections (upstream, bend apex, downstream)
   - Channel Sinuosity (Channel Length / Straight Line Distance)

4. Save all measurements to a CSV file at '~/ImageJ_Data/results/river_morphometry.csv'.
The file must contain the area, the three width measurements, and the calculated sinuosity index. You can format it as a simple list of keys and values or a table.

metadata.image_source: Fiji built-in sample (File > Open Samples > Nile Bend)
